validated_properties: One durable RESERVE record exists per block/slot key. A second same-slot reservation is rejected even if the request is identical; a conflicting request binding is also rejected.
The default retry policy is fail-closed unresolved: an uncommitted reservation survives recovery but cannot be converted into a new launch permit.
Launch permits are MAC-bound to a process-epoch secret, so a permit from a crashed/restarted process cannot be reused after module reinitialization.

Deterministic replay is a separate explicit policy. Recovery may reissue a new process-epoch permit only for the exact same durable capability/request/attempt identity and only while no COMMIT exists.
A COMMIT record binds the durable reservation to a slot-event digest and makes all later launch permits invalid for that slot.
scope: The process-restart check was simulated by importing the module under a fresh module instance, producing a new boot secret; this validates permit-epoch binding but is not an OS-level crash test of secret lifecycle.

The sidecar reservation ledger is launch-control state, while the original ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE journal remains scientific score truth. Atomicity between the two files is not assumed; disagreement fails closed and can reduce coverage/throughput rather than silently admitting a different score.
The ledger still relies on its DurableAppendWriter for writer serialization. Whole-file CAS without flock/lease/fencing is insufficient if multiple OS processes can reserve concurrently.
Deterministic replay is valid only if the scorer actually maps attempt_id to the same statistical attempt under all relevant RNG/runtime settings. Otherwise the safe policy is fail-closed unresolved.
Exact production sibling byte-execution remains pending in a repository-local runtime.
frontier: Integrate AttemptLaunchPermit validation into the score-launch wrapper so score generation requires both the durable ADMIT capability and the durable one-attempt permit.
Add a cooperating multi-process writer fence/flock around reservation CAS+append+fsync if the actual launcher can have concurrent processes, then stress simultaneous same-slot reservations.
Define crash recovery after RESERVE but before score/SLOT for the fail-closed policy as an explicit missing/failure score path at block close, and verify no hidden retry selection channel remains.
For deterministic replay mode, test real scorer/runtime reproducibility under fixed attempt_id before enabling that mode outside synthetic harnesses.
Byte-execute reservation/gate/writer/score wrapper with exact production durable adapter/V3/K-guard siblings.
